parameters.query:
select r.* from user_roles ur 
join roles r on ur.role_id = r.id
where ur.user_id = '{{ $json.query.user_id }}'

SELECT sc.* FROM user_services s
INNER JOIN service_catalog sc ON s.service_id = sc.id
WHERE s.user_id = $1

WITH quote_financials AS (
    SELECT
        o.quote_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN i.total       ELSE -i.total      END) AS monto_facturado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN COALESCE(i.paid_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS monto_pagado
    FROM public.invoices i
    JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE i.status != 'cancel'
    GROUP BY o.quote_id
)
SELECT
    q.id,
    q.user_id,
    u.name                                        AS user_name,
    q.total                                       AS total_presupuesto,
    q.status,
    q.billing_status,
    q.payment_status,
    q.created_at,
    q.currency,
    q.doc_no,
    q.exchange_rate,
    q.notes,

    COALESCE(qf.monto_facturado, 0)               AS monto_facturado,
    COALESCE(qf.monto_pagado,    0)               AS monto_pagado,

    q.total - COALESCE(qf.monto_facturado, 0)     AS pendiente_facturar,

    COALESCE(qf.monto_facturado, 0)
        - COALESCE(qf.monto_pagado, 0)            AS pendiente_pago_facturado,

    q.external_id

FROM public.quotes q
INNER JOIN public.users u ON u.id = q.user_id
LEFT JOIN quote_financials qf ON qf.quote_id = q.id
WHERE q.user_id = $1
ORDER BY q.created_at DESC;

SELECT * FROM access_logs
WHERE user_id = '{{ $json.query.user_id }}'

SELECT ur.user_id, ur.role_id, ur.is_active, r.name, r.description
FROM public.user_roles ur
JOIN roles r on ur.role_id = r.id
WHERE ur.user_id = $1;

SELECT
  -- Validación de Email
  CASE 
    WHEN $1 IS NOT NULL AND $1 <> '' 
    THEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = $1 AND id <> $4))
    ELSE false 
  END AS email_exists,

  -- Validación de Teléfono
  CASE 
    WHEN $2 IS NOT NULL AND $2 <> '' 
    THEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE phone_number = $2 AND id <> $4))
    ELSE false 
  END AS telefono_exists,

  -- Validación de Documento de Identidad
  CASE 
    WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL AND $3 <> '' 
    THEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE identity_document = $3 AND id <> $4))
    ELSE false 
  END AS identity_document_exists;

SELECT
  -- Validación de Email
  CASE 
    WHEN $1 IS NOT NULL AND $1 <> '' 
    THEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = $1))
    ELSE false 
  END AS email_exists,

  -- Validación de Teléfono
  CASE 
    WHEN $2 IS NOT NULL AND $2 <> '' 
    THEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE phone_number = $2))
    ELSE false 
  END AS telefono_exists,

  -- Validación de Documento de Identidad
  CASE 
    WHEN $3 IS NOT NULL AND $3 <> '' 
    THEN (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE identity_document = $3))
    ELSE false 
  END AS identity_document_exists;

SELECT 
    us.user_id, 
    us.service_id AS id, 
    us.enabled AS is_active, 
    s.price, 
    s.name, 
    s.created_at, 
    s.description,
    COALESCE(us.duration_minutes, s.duration_minutes) AS duration_minutes,
    s.category, 
    s.indications
FROM public.user_services us 
JOIN public.service_catalog s ON s.id = us.service_id
WHERE us.user_id = $1;

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.is_active
FROM users u
INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.id
    AND ur.role_id = '2'
    AND ur.is_active = true
WHERE ($1 IS NULL OR u.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%');

SELECT u.id, u.name
	FROM users u INNER JOIN user_roles ur on ur.user_id = u.id and ur.role_id='1' and ur.is_active = true;

SELECT i.*, o.doc_no as order_doc_no, q.doc_no as quote_doc_no, u.name as user_name
  FROM public.invoices i
LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = i.user_id
WHERE i.user_id = $1
ORDER BY created_at DESC

WITH all_transactions AS (
    -- BLOQUE 1: PAGOS DIRECTOS
    SELECT 
        p.id AS transaction_id,
        p.created_at,
        u.name AS user_name,
        p.doc_no AS transaction_doc_no,
        p.doc_no AS source_doc_no,
        i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        'direct_payment' AS transaction_type,
        ABS(COALESCE(p.converted_amount, p.amount)) AS amount_applied, 
        ABS(p.amount) AS source_amount,
        p.currency AS source_currency,
        p.exchange_rate,
        pm.name AS payment_method_name,
        pm.code AS payment_method_code,
        p.is_sales,
        p.doc_no,
        p.invoice_id,
        p.notes,
        p.is_historical,
        p.external_id,
        p.doctor_id
    FROM public.payments p
    INNER JOIN public.users u ON p.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN public.invoices i ON p.invoice_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN public.payment_methods pm ON p.payment_method_id = pm.id
    WHERE p.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    -- BLOQUE 2: ASIGNACIONES DE PAGOS (Remanentes aplicados a otras facturas)
    SELECT 
        pa.id AS transaction_id,
        pa.created_at,
        u.name AS user_name,
        CONCAT(orig_p.doc_no, '-A', pa.id) AS transaction_doc_no, 
        orig_p.doc_no AS source_doc_no,
        i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        'payment_allocation' AS transaction_type,
        ABS(pa.target_amount) AS amount_applied,
        ABS(pa.amount) AS source_amount,
        orig_p.currency AS source_currency,
        pa.exchange_rate,
        pm.name AS payment_method_name,
        pm.code AS payment_method_code,
        orig_p.is_sales,
        CONCAT(orig_p.doc_no, '-A', pa.id) AS doc_no, 
        pa.invoice_id,
        '' AS notes,
        false AS is_historical,
        null AS external_id,
        null AS doctor_id
    FROM public.payment_allocations pa
    JOIN public.payments orig_p ON pa.payment_id = orig_p.id
    LEFT JOIN public.invoices i ON pa.invoice_id = i.id
    LEFT JOIN public.users u ON orig_p.user_id = u.id
    LEFT JOIN public.payment_methods pm ON orig_p.payment_method_id = pm.id
    WHERE orig_p.user_id = $1
      AND (orig_p.invoice_id IS DISTINCT FROM pa.invoice_id)

    UNION ALL

    -- BLOQUE 3: ASIGNACIONES DE NOTAS DE CRÉDITO
    SELECT 
        ia.id AS transaction_id,
        ia.created_at,
        u.name AS user_name,
        CONCAT(nc.doc_no, '-A', ia.id) AS transaction_doc_no, 
        nc.doc_no AS source_doc_no,
        target_i.doc_no AS invoice_doc_no,
        'credit_note_allocation' AS transaction_type,
        ABS(ia.target_amount) AS amount_applied,
        ABS(ia.amount) AS source_amount,
        nc.currency AS source_currency,
        ia.exchange_rate,
        'Credit Note' AS payment_method_name,
        'CN' AS payment_method_code,
        target_i.is_sales,
        CONCAT(nc.doc_no, '-A', ia.id) AS doc_no, 
        ia.target_id AS invoice_id,
        '' AS notes,
        false AS is_historical,
        null AS external_id,
        null AS doctor_id
    FROM public.invoice_allocations ia
    JOIN public.invoices nc ON ia.source_id = nc.id
    JOIN public.invoices target_i ON ia.target_id = target_i.id
    JOIN public.users u ON target_i.user_id = u.id
    WHERE target_i.user_id = $1
)
SELECT * FROM all_transactions
ORDER BY created_at DESC, transaction_id DESC;

SELECT o.*, q.doc_no as quote_doc_no FROM orders as o
LEFT JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
WHERE o.user_id = $1
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT 
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.name AS patient_name,
    u.email,
    u.identity_document,
    i.currency,
    COUNT(i.id) as pending_invoices_count,
    SUM(i.total - i.paid_amount) as total_debt_amount
FROM 
    public.users u
JOIN 
    public.invoices i ON u.id = i.user_id
WHERE 
    -- 1. Filtro de Rol: Solo Pacientes (Tomado de tu función)
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
        JOIN public.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id
        WHERE ur.user_id = u.id
        AND r.name = 'paciente'
    )
    -- 2. Filtro de Factura Válida (Tipo factura, no Nota de Crédito)
    AND i.type = 'invoice'
    -- 3. Estado "Booked" (Confirmada)
    AND i.status = 'booked'
    -- 4. Que no haya sido pagada totalmente
    AND i.payment_state IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid')
GROUP BY 
    u.id, u.name, u.email, u.identity_document, i.currency
ORDER BY 
    total_debt_amount DESC;
SELECT appointment_date FROM public.users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

WITH service_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        ii.invoice_id,
        jsonb_agg(sc.name ORDER BY ii.id) AS services_list
    FROM public.invoice_items ii
    JOIN public.service_catalog sc ON ii.service_id = sc.id
    GROUP BY ii.invoice_id
),
payment_refs AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.payment_id,
        jsonb_agg(i.doc_no ORDER BY i.doc_no) AS allocated_invoices
    FROM public.payment_allocations pa
    JOIN public.invoices i ON pa.invoice_id = i.id
    GROUP BY pa.payment_id
),
credit_note_refs AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.source_id AS credit_note_id,
        jsonb_agg(i.doc_no ORDER BY i.doc_no) AS target_invoices
    FROM public.invoice_allocations ia
    JOIN public.invoices i ON ia.target_id = i.id
    GROUP BY ia.source_id
),
all_movements AS (
    -- Unificamos todos los documentos primero
    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency, i.created_at, 'invoice' AS document_type, i.doc_no, i.total AS amount,
        jsonb_build_object('label', 'Factura', 'doc_no', i.doc_no, 'services', COALESCE(sa.services_list, '[]'::jsonb), 'notes', i.notes) AS metadata,
        i.id AS internal_id
    FROM public.invoices i
    LEFT JOIN service_agg sa ON i.id = sa.invoice_id
    WHERE i.type = 'invoice' AND i.status = 'booked'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency, i.created_at, 'credit_note' AS document_type, i.doc_no, -i.total AS amount,
        jsonb_build_object('label', 'Nota de Crédito', 'doc_no', i.doc_no, 'applied_to', COALESCE(cnr.target_invoices, '[]'::jsonb), 'services', COALESCE(sa.services_list, '[]'::jsonb), 'notes', i.notes) AS metadata,
        i.id AS internal_id
    FROM public.invoices i
    LEFT JOIN service_agg sa ON i.id = sa.invoice_id
    LEFT JOIN credit_note_refs cnr ON i.id = cnr.credit_note_id
    WHERE i.type = 'credit_note' AND i.status = 'booked'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        p.user_id, p.currency, p.created_at, 'payment' AS document_type, p.doc_no, -p.amount AS amount,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'label', 'Pago',
            'payment_type', CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Directo' WHEN pr.allocated_invoices IS NOT NULL THEN 'Prepago Aplicado' ELSE 'A cuenta' END,
            'target_invoices', CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_array((SELECT doc_no FROM public.invoices WHERE id = p.invoice_id)) ELSE COALESCE(pr.allocated_invoices, '[]'::jsonb) END,
            'notes', p.notes
        ) AS metadata,
        p.id AS internal_id
    FROM public.payments p
    LEFT JOIN payment_refs pr ON p.id = pr.payment_id
),
history_calculated AS (
    -- 1. CAMBIO: Añadida prioridad por tipo de documento para desempatar el saldo progresivo
    SELECT 
        *,
        SUM(amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id, currency 
            ORDER BY 
                created_at ASC, 
                CASE 
                    WHEN document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
                    WHEN document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
                    ELSE 3 
                END ASC,
                internal_id ASC
        ) AS running_balance
    FROM all_movements
),
opening_balances AS (
    -- 2. CAMBIO: Añadida prioridad en orden DESC para asegurar que se tome el último saldo correcto del segundo en conflicto
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, currency)
        user_id, currency, running_balance
    FROM history_calculated
    WHERE ($2 IS NOT NULL AND created_at < $2)
    ORDER BY 
        user_id, 
        currency, 
        created_at DESC, 
        CASE 
            WHEN document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
            WHEN document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
            ELSE 3 
        END DESC,
        internal_id DESC
),
closing_balances AS (
    -- 3. CAMBIO: Añadida prioridad idéntica a opening_balances para el saldo final
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, currency)
        user_id, currency, running_balance
    FROM history_calculated
    WHERE ($3 IS NULL OR created_at <= $3)
    ORDER BY 
        user_id, 
        currency, 
        created_at DESC, 
        CASE 
            WHEN document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
            WHEN document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
            ELSE 3 
        END DESC,
        internal_id DESC
)
SELECT 
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.name,
    u.email,
    u.phone_number,
    u.identity_document,
    $2 AS report_start_date,
    $3 AS report_end_date,
    jsonb_object_agg(
        hc.currency, 
        jsonb_build_object(
            'initial_balance', COALESCE((SELECT running_balance FROM opening_balances ob WHERE ob.user_id = u.id AND ob.currency = hc.currency), 0),
            'final_balance', COALESCE((SELECT running_balance FROM closing_balances cb WHERE cb.user_id = u.id AND cb.currency = hc.currency), 0),
            'movements', (
                -- 4. CAMBIO: Alineado el orden del array JSON con el mismo criterio matemático del saldo progresivo
                SELECT jsonb_agg(h ORDER BY 
                    h.created_at ASC, 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN h.document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
                        WHEN h.document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
                        ELSE 3 
                    END ASC, 
                    h.internal_id ASC
                )
                FROM history_calculated h 
                WHERE h.user_id = u.id 
                  AND h.currency = hc.currency
                  AND (h.created_at >= $2 OR $2 IS NULL)
                  AND (h.created_at <= $3 OR $3 IS NULL)
            )
        )
    ) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM history_calculated h2 
        WHERE h2.user_id = u.id 
          AND h2.currency = hc.currency
          AND (h2.created_at >= $2 OR $2 IS NULL)
          AND (h2.created_at <= $3 OR $3 IS NULL)
    )) AS history_by_currency
FROM public.users u
JOIN history_calculated hc ON u.id = hc.user_id
WHERE u.id = $1
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.identity_document;

WITH all_movements AS (
    -- 1. FACTURAS
    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency, 'invoice' AS type,
        CASE WHEN u.is_sales THEN i.total ELSE -i.total END AS amount
    FROM public.invoices i
    JOIN public.users u ON i.user_id = u.id
    WHERE i.status = 'booked' AND i.type = 'invoice' AND i.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. NOTAS DE CRÉDITO
    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency, 'credit_note' AS type,
        CASE WHEN u.is_sales THEN -i.total ELSE i.total END AS amount
    FROM public.invoices i
    JOIN public.users u ON i.user_id = u.id
    WHERE i.status = 'booked' AND i.type = 'credit_note' AND i.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    -- 3. PAGOS (El ingreso bruto de dinero)
    SELECT 
        p.user_id, p.currency, 'payment' AS type,
        -p.amount AS amount
    FROM public.payments p
    WHERE p.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    -- 4. COMPENSACIÓN: Pagos con invoice_id directo
    SELECT 
        p.user_id, p.currency AS currency, 'compensation' AS type,
        p.amount AS amount 
    FROM public.payments p
    WHERE p.user_id = $1 AND p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        p.user_id, p.invoice_currency AS currency, 'compensation' AS type,
        -p.converted_amount AS amount 
    FROM public.payments p
    WHERE p.user_id = $1 AND p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- 5. COMPENSACIÓN: Tabla payment_allocations
    SELECT 
        p.user_id, p.currency AS currency, 'compensation' AS type,
        pa.amount AS amount
    FROM public.payment_allocations pa
    JOIN public.payments p ON pa.payment_id = p.id
    WHERE p.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        p.user_id, i.currency AS currency, 'compensation' AS type,
        -pa.target_amount AS amount
    FROM public.payment_allocations pa
    JOIN public.invoices i ON pa.invoice_id = i.id
    JOIN public.payments p ON pa.payment_id = p.id
    WHERE p.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    -- 6. COMPENSACIÓN: Tabla invoice_allocations (NC aplicadas a Facturas)
    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency AS currency, 'compensation' AS type,
        ia.amount AS amount
    FROM public.invoice_allocations ia
    JOIN public.invoices i ON ia.source_id = i.id
    WHERE i.user_id = $1

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        i_target.user_id, i_target.currency AS currency, 'compensation' AS type,
        -ia.target_amount AS amount
    FROM public.invoice_allocations ia
    JOIN public.invoices i_target ON ia.target_id = i_target.id
    WHERE i_target.user_id = $1
),
financial_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        user_id,
        currency,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'invoice' THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_invoiced,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit_note' THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit_notes,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'payment' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_paid,
        SUM(amount) AS net_balance
    FROM all_movements
    GROUP BY user_id, currency
)
SELECT 
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.is_sales,
    jsonb_object_agg(
        fs.currency, 
        jsonb_build_object(
            'total_invoiced', fs.total_invoiced,
            'total_credit_notes', fs.total_credit_notes,
            'total_paid', fs.total_paid,
            'current_debt', CASE 
                WHEN u.is_sales THEN GREATEST(fs.net_balance, 0)
                ELSE ABS(LEAST(fs.net_balance, 0))
            END,
            'available_balance', CASE 
                WHEN u.is_sales THEN ABS(LEAST(fs.net_balance, 0))
                ELSE GREATEST(fs.net_balance, 0)
            END,
            'account_status', fs.net_balance
        )
    ) AS financial_data
FROM public.users u
JOIN financial_summary fs ON u.id = fs.user_id
WHERE u.id = $1
GROUP BY u.id, u.is_sales;

SELECT 
    s.user_id, 
    jsonb_agg(
        to_jsonb(sc.*) || jsonb_build_object(
            'price', COALESCE(s.custom_price, sc.price),
            'duration_minutes', COALESCE(s.duration_minutes, sc.duration_minutes),
            'is_enabled_for_user', s.enabled
        )
    ) AS services
FROM user_services s
INNER JOIN service_catalog sc ON s.service_id = sc.id
WHERE s.user_id = ANY($1::uuid[])
GROUP BY s.user_id;

SELECT d.id, d.name, d.address, d.email, d.phone_number FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.users d ON d.id = u.responsible_contact_id
WHERE u.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

options.systemMessage:
=## Identidad
Eres **Invoke IA**, la asistente inteligente de una clínica odontológica. Tu función principal es **interpretar la intención del doctor y devolver
una respuesta operativa junto con, si corresponde, una única acción estructurada** para que la interfaz ejecute el cambio correcto de contexto.

## Fecha y hora
Fecha/Hora actual: {{ $now.toISO() }}
Zona horaria: America/Montevideo

## Función
Tu objetivo es facilitarle el trabajo al doctor respondiendo de forma coherente, elegante, breve y clínicamente útil. Debes ayudar a resolver la
tarea con el menor número de pasos posible, pero sin inventar datos ni asumir contexto no confirmado. Estás limitado solamente a utilizar las herramnientas que se te dan y responder consultas de acuerdo al dominio que se te ha dado y la información a la que tienes acceso.

## Datos del doctor
{{ $json.toJsonString() }}

## Regla principal de operación
Cuando el doctor pide abrir una vista, cambiar de contexto, revisar otra cita, registrar una sesión o ir a una pestaña concreta, debes decidir si
hace falta devolver una acción de interfaz.

- Si basta con responder texto, devuelve `"action": null`.
- Si hace falta abrir una vista o cambiar contexto, devuelve **una sola acción**.
- No combines varias acciones en la misma respuesta.
- Si la acción debe ejecutarse sobre una cita distinta a la actual, incluye `appointment_id`.
- Si la acción aplica sobre la cita actualmente en foco y eso está claro en el contexto, puedes omitir `appointment_id`.
- Si no tienes certeza de cuál cita debe usarse, pide confirmación en `output` y deja `"action": null`.

## Flujo de confirmación para sesiones clínicas
Cuando el doctor te pide registrar una sesión clínica, distingue la intención:

**Si el doctor pide "completar", "abrir", "revisar" o "ver" la sesión:**
→ Devuelve directamente `revisar_sesion` con los datos inferidos o dictados, sin pedir confirmación previa.
  En `output`, indica brevemente qué datos pre-cargaste.

**Si el doctor pide "guardar", "registrar" o "crear" la sesión:**
Sigue el flujo de dos pasos:

**Paso 1 — Preparar datos:** Devuelve `sesion_clinica` con los datos inferidos. En tu `output`, avisa que los datos están listos y pregunta si desea guardarlos directamente o revisarlos antes. No digas que "guardaste" ni que "creaste" nada todavía.

**Paso 2 — Actuar según la respuesta:** Cuando el doctor conteste:
- Si confirma guardar → devuelve `guardar_sesion` con los datos (o modificados si pidió cambios).
- Si quiere revisar → devuelve `revisar_sesion` con los mismos datos.
- Si pide cambiar algún dato → actualiza y vuelve al Paso 1.

Si `has_existing_session` es `true`, usa verbos de edición ("editar", "actualizar") en lugar de ("crear", "registrar"). El flujo es el mismo según la intención.

## Formato de salida esperado
Devuelve SIEMPRE un objeto JSON con esta forma exacta:

{
  "output": "Respuesta breve, clara y útil para el doctor.",
  "action": {
    "type": "tipo_de_accion",
    "...": "campos adicionales según la acción"
  }
}

Si no hace falta ejecutar ninguna acción, devuelve:

{
  "output": "Respuesta breve, clara y útil para el doctor.",
  "action": null
}

## Tipos de acción permitidos

1. `revisar_sesion`
Prepara los datos de una sesión clínica y espera confirmación del doctor; no puedes omitir detalles.
Campos permitidos:
- `procedimiento_realizado`: string
- `plan_proxima_cita`: string
- `tratamientos`: array de objetos `{ "diente": number, "tratamiento": string }`

2. `guardar_sesion`
El doctor confirmó que quiere guardar directamente sin revisar.
Mismos campos que `sesion_clinica`. Incluye los datos completos (los mismos que preparaste, o actualizados si pidió cambios).

3. `abrir_odontograma`
Abre el odontograma y comienza una sesión con los datos pre-cargados.
Campos permitidos:
- `procedimiento_realizado`: string — título de la sesión (ej. "Limpieza dental")
- `notas_clinicas`: string — notas clínicas dictadas por el doctor
- `plan_proxima_cita`: string — plan para la siguiente visita
Úsala cuando el doctor quiera trabajar con el odontograma o marcar condiciones dentales.
Campos de `marcaciones` (array):
- `diente`: string con número FDI (ej. "16", "48")
- `condicion`: uno de: caries · filling · crown · missing · endodontics · fracture · implant · pulp · worn · healthy · dyschromic · crown-tmp · root-remnant · prosthesis · fixed-prosth · edentulism
- `superficie`: "center" (oclusal) · "top" (vestibular) · "bottom" (lingual) · "left" (mesial) · "right" (distal) · "whole" (toda la pieza) · "overlay" (superposición)

Si el doctor dice "caries en diente 16 oclusal" → `{ diente: "16", condicion: "caries", superficie: "center" }`
Si dice "diente 48 ausente" → `{ diente: "48", condicion: "missing", superficie: "whole" }`

## Estilo de respuesta
- Sé breve, clínicamente claro y operativo.
- No expliques las reglas.
- No menciones nombres internos de acciones en `output`.
- No digas que "vas a abrir" algo si no estás devolviendo una acción válida.
- Si falta información, pide una aclaración puntual y concreta.

WITH cte_alergias AS (
    SELECT 
        paciente_id,
        json_agg(json_build_object(
            'alergeno', alergeno, 
            'reaccion', reaccion_descrita
        )) AS alergias
    FROM public.alergias_paciente
    GROUP BY paciente_id
),
cte_familiares AS (
    SELECT 
        af.paciente_id,
        json_agg(json_build_object(
            'parentesco', af.parentesco, 
            'padecimiento', COALESCE(cp.nombre, af.padecimiento_id), -- Si no está en catálogo, usa el texto original
            'categoria', cp.categoria,
            'nivel_alerta', cp.nivel_alerta,
            'comentarios', af.comentarios
        )) AS antecedentes_familiares
    FROM public.antecedentes_familiares af
    LEFT JOIN public.catalogo_padecimientos cp ON af.padecimiento_id = cp.nombre
    GROUP BY af.paciente_id
),
cte_personales AS (
    SELECT 
        ap.paciente_id,
        json_agg(json_build_object(
            'padecimiento', COALESCE(cp.nombre, ap.padecimiento_id), -- Si no está en catálogo, usa el texto original
            'categoria', cp.categoria,
            'nivel_alerta', cp.nivel_alerta,
            'comentarios', ap.comentarios
        )) AS antecedentes_personales
    FROM public.antecedentes_personales ap
    LEFT JOIN public.catalogo_padecimientos cp ON ap.padecimiento_id = cp.nombre
    GROUP BY ap.paciente_id
),
cte_medicamentos AS (
    SELECT 
        m.paciente_id,
        json_agg(json_build_object(
            'nombre_generico', cat.nombre_generico,
            'nombre_comercial', cat.nombre_comercial,
            'medicamento_texto', m.medicamento_texto,
            'dosis', m.dosis,
            'frecuencia', m.frecuencia,
            'fecha_inicio', m.fecha_inicio,
            'fecha_fin', m.fecha_fin,
            'motivo', m.motivo
        )) AS historial_medicamentos
    FROM public.historial_medicamentos_paciente m
    LEFT JOIN public.catalogo_medicamentos cat ON m.medicamento_id = cat.id
    GROUP BY m.paciente_id
)

SELECT 
    u.id AS paciente_id,
    h.tabaquismo,
    h.alcohol,
    h.bruxismo,
    h.fecha_actualizacion AS habitos_ultima_actualizacion,
    COALESCE(al.alergias, '[]'::json) AS alergias,
    COALESCE(af.antecedentes_familiares, '[]'::json) AS antecedentes_familiares,
    COALESCE(ap.antecedentes_personales, '[]'::json) AS antecedentes_personales,
    COALESCE(med.historial_medicamentos, '[]'::json) AS historial_medicamentos
FROM public.users u
LEFT JOIN public.habitos_paciente h ON u.id = h.paciente_id
LEFT JOIN cte_alergias al ON u.id = al.paciente_id
LEFT JOIN cte_familiares af ON u.id = af.paciente_id
LEFT JOIN cte_personales ap ON u.id = ap.paciente_id
LEFT JOIN cte_medicamentos med ON u.id = med.paciente_id
WHERE u.id = $1;

WITH todas_las_sesiones AS (
    SELECT
        sc.paciente_id,
        sc.fecha_sesion,
        sc.id,
        sc.id AS sesion_id_raw,
        json_build_object(
            'sesion_id', sc.id,
            'tipo_sesion', 'clinica',
            'fecha_sesion', sc.fecha_sesion,
            'diagnostico', sc.diagnostico,
            'procedimiento_realizado', sc.procedimiento_realizado,
            'notas_clinicas', sc.notas_clinicas,
            'notas', sc.notas_clinicas,
            'doctor_id', sc.doctor_id,
            'nombre_doctor', d.name,
            'estado_odontograma', null,
            'plan_proxima_cita', sc.plan_proxima_cita,
            'fecha_proxima_cita', sc.fecha_proxima_cita,
            'quote_id', sc.quote_id,
            'quote_doc_no', p.doc_no,
            'appointment_id', sc.appointment_id,
            'tratamientos', COALESCE((
                SELECT json_agg(
                    json_build_object(
                        'numero_diente', ts.numero_diente,
                        'descripcion', ts.descripcion_tratamiento
                    )
                )
                FROM tratamientos_sesion ts
                WHERE ts.sesion_id = sc.id
            ), '[]'::json),
            'archivos_adjuntos', COALESCE((
                SELECT json_agg(
                    json_build_object(
                        'id', aas.id,
                        'web_view_link', aas.web_view_link,
                        'file_name', aas.file_name,
                        'mime_type', aas.mime_type,
                        'created_at', aas.created_at,
                        'drive_file_id', aas.drive_file_id,
                        'thumbnail_link', aas.thumbnail_link
                    )
                )
                FROM public.attachments aas
                WHERE aas.source_id = sc.id::text AND aas.source_name = 'clinic_history_session'
            ), '[]'::json)
        ) AS sesion_json
    FROM
        sesiones_clinicas sc
    LEFT JOIN users d ON sc.doctor_id = d.id
    LEFT JOIN quotes p ON sc.quote_id = p.id 

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        s.paciente_id,
        s.fecha_sesion,
        s.id,
        s.id AS sesion_id_raw,
        json_build_object(
            'sesion_id', s.id,
            'tipo_sesion', 'odontograma',
            'fecha_sesion', s.fecha_sesion,
            'diagnostico', null,
            'procedimiento_realizado', s.descripcion,
            'notas_clinicas', s.notas,
            'notas', s.notas,
            'doctor_id', s.doctor_id,
            'nombre_doctor', d2.name,
            'estado_odontograma', s.estado_odontograma,
            'plan_proxima_cita', s.proximo_control_desc,
            'fecha_proxima_cita', s.fecha_proximo_control,
            'quote_id', null,
            'quote_doc_no', null,
            'appointment_id', null,
            'tratamientos', '[]'::json,
            'archivos_adjuntos', COALESCE((
                SELECT json_agg(
                    json_build_object(
                        'id', aas.id,
                        'web_view_link', aas.web_view_link,
                        'file_name', aas.file_name,
                        'mime_type', aas.mime_type,
                        'created_at', aas.created_at,
                        'drive_file_id', aas.drive_file_id,
                        'thumbnail_link', aas.thumbnail_link
                    )
                )
                FROM public.attachments aas
                WHERE aas.source_id = s.id::text AND aas.source_name = 'clinic_history_session'
            ), '[]'::json)
        ) AS sesion_json
    FROM
        sesiones s
    LEFT JOIN users d2 ON s.doctor_id = d2.id
)
SELECT
    sesion_json
FROM
    todas_las_sesiones
WHERE
  ($2 = 0 and paciente_id = $1)
   OR ($2 != 0 and id = $2)
ORDER BY
    fecha_sesion DESC, 
    sesion_id_raw DESC;

SELECT
    u.name, 
    u.identity_document, 
    u.birthday, 
    u.appointment_date,

    ms.name AS mutual_society_name,

LEFT JOIN public.mutual_societies ms

SELECT * FROM public.appointments
WHERE id = $1

SELECT COALESCE(
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'id',              ts.id::text,
      'service_id',      ts.service_id::text,
      'service_name',    COALESCE(sc.name, 'Servicio desconocido'),
      'service_color',   sc.color,
      'status',          ts.status,
      'started_at',      ts.started_at::text,
      'expected_end_at', ts.expected_end_at::text,
      'doctor_id',       ts.started_by::text,
      'doctor_name',     u.name,
      'notes',           ts.notes,
      'created_at',      ts.created_at::text,
      'steps', (
        SELECT COALESCE(
          json_agg(
            json_build_object(
              'id',               ss.id::text,
              'step_number',      ss.step_position,
              'step_name',        ss.step_name,
              'scheduled_date',   COALESCE(
                                    a.start_datetime::date::text,
                                    ss.scheduled_date::text
                                  ),
              'appointment_id',   ss.appointment_id::text,
              'duration_minutes', ss.duration_minutes,
              'sesion_id',        ss.sesion_id,
              'status',           CASE ss.milestone_status
                                    WHEN 'done'    THEN 'completed'
                                    WHEN 'waiting' THEN 'scheduled'
                                    WHEN 'alert'   THEN 'missed'
                                    ELSE 'pending'
                                  END,
              'milestone_status', ss.milestone_status,
              'notes',            ss.notes
            )
            ORDER BY ss.step_position
          ),
          '[]'::json
        )
        FROM treatment_seq_steps ss
        LEFT JOIN appointments a ON a.id = ss.appointment_id
        WHERE ss.sequence_id = ts.id
      )
    )
    ORDER BY
      CASE ts.status WHEN 'active' THEN 0 WHEN 'paused' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
      ts.started_at DESC
  ),
  '[]'::json
) AS result
FROM treatment_sequences ts
LEFT JOIN service_catalog sc ON sc.id = ts.service_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = ts.started_by
WHERE ts.patient_id = $1

SELECT 
  id, email, phone_number, name, created_at, updated_at, is_active, identity_document, color, birthday, appointment_date, notes, drive_folder_id, address, is_dependant, responsible_contact_id, mutual_society_id
FROM public.users
WHERE id = $1

WITH service_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        ii.invoice_id,
        jsonb_agg(sc.name ORDER BY ii.id) AS services_list
    FROM public.invoice_items ii
    JOIN public.service_catalog sc ON ii.service_id = sc.id
    GROUP BY ii.invoice_id
),
payment_refs AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.payment_id,
        jsonb_agg(i.doc_no ORDER BY i.doc_no) AS allocated_invoices
    FROM public.payment_allocations pa
    JOIN public.invoices i ON pa.invoice_id = i.id
    GROUP BY pa.payment_id
),
credit_note_refs AS (
    SELECT 
        ia.source_id AS credit_note_id,
        jsonb_agg(i.doc_no ORDER BY i.doc_no) AS target_invoices
    FROM public.invoice_allocations ia
    JOIN public.invoices i ON ia.target_id = i.id
    GROUP BY ia.source_id
),
all_movements AS (
    -- Unificamos todos los documentos primero
    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency, i.created_at, 'invoice' AS document_type, i.doc_no, i.total AS amount,
        jsonb_build_object('label', 'Factura', 'doc_no', i.doc_no, 'services', COALESCE(sa.services_list, '[]'::jsonb), 'notes', i.notes) AS metadata,
        i.id AS internal_id
    FROM public.invoices i
    LEFT JOIN service_agg sa ON i.id = sa.invoice_id
    WHERE i.type = 'invoice' AND i.status = 'booked'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        i.user_id, i.currency, i.created_at, 'credit_note' AS document_type, i.doc_no, -i.total AS amount,
        jsonb_build_object('label', 'Nota de Crédito', 'doc_no', i.doc_no, 'applied_to', COALESCE(cnr.target_invoices, '[]'::jsonb), 'services', COALESCE(sa.services_list, '[]'::jsonb), 'notes', i.notes) AS metadata,
        i.id AS internal_id
    FROM public.invoices i
    LEFT JOIN service_agg sa ON i.id = sa.invoice_id
    LEFT JOIN credit_note_refs cnr ON i.id = cnr.credit_note_id
    WHERE i.type = 'credit_note' AND i.status = 'booked'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 
        p.user_id, p.currency, p.created_at, 'payment' AS document_type, p.doc_no, -p.amount AS amount,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'label', 'Pago',
            'payment_type', CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Directo' WHEN pr.allocated_invoices IS NOT NULL THEN 'Prepago Aplicado' ELSE 'A cuenta' END,
            'target_invoices', CASE WHEN p.invoice_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_array((SELECT doc_no FROM public.invoices WHERE id = p.invoice_id)) ELSE COALESCE(pr.allocated_invoices, '[]'::jsonb) END,
            'notes', p.notes
        ) AS metadata,
        p.id AS internal_id
    FROM public.payments p
    LEFT JOIN payment_refs pr ON p.id = pr.payment_id
),
history_calculated AS (
    -- 1. CAMBIO: Añadida prioridad por tipo de documento para desempatar el saldo progresivo
    SELECT 
        *,
        SUM(amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY user_id, currency 
            ORDER BY 
                created_at ASC, 
                CASE 
                    WHEN document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
                    WHEN document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
                    ELSE 3 
                END ASC,
                internal_id ASC
        ) AS running_balance
    FROM all_movements
),
opening_balances AS (
    -- 2. CAMBIO: Añadida prioridad en orden DESC para asegurar que se tome el último saldo correcto del segundo en conflicto
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, currency)
        user_id, currency, running_balance
    FROM history_calculated
    WHERE ($2 IS NOT NULL AND created_at < $2)
    ORDER BY 
        user_id, 
        currency, 
        created_at DESC, 
        CASE 
            WHEN document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
            WHEN document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
            ELSE 3 
        END DESC,
        internal_id DESC
),
closing_balances AS (
    -- 3. CAMBIO: Añadida prioridad idéntica a opening_balances para el saldo final
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id, currency)
        user_id, currency, running_balance
    FROM history_calculated
    WHERE ($3 IS NULL OR created_at <= $3)
    ORDER BY 
        user_id, 
        currency, 
        created_at DESC, 
        CASE 
            WHEN document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
            WHEN document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
            ELSE 3 
        END DESC,
        internal_id DESC
)
SELECT 
    u.id AS user_id,
    u.name,
    u.email,
    u.phone_number,
    u.identity_document,
    $2 AS report_start_date,
    $3 AS report_end_date,
    jsonb_object_agg(
        hc.currency, 
        jsonb_build_object(
            'initial_balance', COALESCE((SELECT running_balance FROM opening_balances ob WHERE ob.user_id = u.id AND ob.currency = hc.currency), 0),
            'final_balance', COALESCE((SELECT running_balance FROM closing_balances cb WHERE cb.user_id = u.id AND cb.currency = hc.currency), 0),
            'movements', (
                -- 4. CAMBIO: Alineado el orden del array JSON con el mismo criterio matemático del saldo progresivo
                SELECT jsonb_agg(h ORDER BY 
                    h.created_at ASC, 
                    CASE 
                        WHEN h.document_type = 'invoice' THEN 1 
                        WHEN h.document_type = 'credit_note' THEN 2 
                        ELSE 3 
                    END ASC, 
                    h.internal_id ASC
                )
                FROM history_calculated h 
                WHERE h.user_id = u.id 
                  AND h.currency = hc.currency
                  AND (h.created_at >= $2 OR $2 IS NULL)
                  AND (h.created_at <= $3 OR $3 IS NULL)
            )
        )
    ) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM history_calculated h2 
        WHERE h2.user_id = u.id 
          AND h2.currency = hc.currency
          AND (h2.created_at >= $2 OR $2 IS NULL)
          AND (h2.created_at <= $3 OR $3 IS NULL)
    )) AS history_by_currency
FROM public.users u
JOIN history_calculated hc ON u.id = hc.user_id
WHERE u.id = $1
GROUP BY u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone_number, u.identity_document;
SELECT id, email, name FROM public.users WHERE id = $1;

WITH quote_financials AS (
    SELECT
        o.quote_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN i.total       ELSE -i.total      END) AS monto_facturado,
        SUM(CASE WHEN i.type = 'invoice' THEN COALESCE(i.paid_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS monto_pagado
    FROM public.invoices i
    JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
    WHERE i.status != 'cancel'
    GROUP BY o.quote_id
)
SELECT
    q.id,
    q.user_id,
    u.name                                        AS user_name,
    q.total                                       AS total_presupuesto,
    q.status,
    q.billing_status,
    q.payment_status,
    q.created_at,
    q.currency,
    q.doc_no,
    q.exchange_rate,
    q.notes,
    q.doctor_id,
    q.sede_id,

    COALESCE(qf.monto_facturado, 0)               AS monto_facturado,
    COALESCE(qf.monto_pagado,    0)               AS monto_pagado,

    q.total - COALESCE(qf.monto_facturado, 0)     AS pendiente_facturar,

    COALESCE(qf.monto_facturado, 0)
        - COALESCE(qf.monto_pagado, 0)            AS pendiente_pago_facturado,

    q.external_id,
    json_agg(
      to_jsonb(qi.*) || jsonb_build_object('service_name', sc.name)
    ) AS quote_items

FROM public.quotes q
INNER JOIN public.users u ON u.id = q.user_id
LEFT JOIN quote_financials qf ON qf.quote_id = q.id
LEFT JOIN quote_items qi ON qi.quote_id = q.id
LEFT JOIN service_catalog sc ON sc.id = qi.service_id
WHERE q.user_id = $1
GROUP BY q.id, u.name, qf.monto_facturado, qf.monto_pagado
ORDER BY q.created_at DESC;

SELECT i.*, 
  o.doc_no as order_doc_no, 
  q.doc_no as quote_doc_no,
  q.id as quote_id,
  u.name as user_name, 
  json_agg(
    to_jsonb(ii.*) || jsonb_build_object('quote_item_id', oi.quote_item_id) || jsonb_build_object('service_name', sc.name)
  ) AS invoice_items
FROM public.invoices i
  LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON i.order_id = o.id
  LEFT JOIN public.quotes q ON o.quote_id = q.id
  LEFT JOIN public.users u ON u.id = i.user_id
  LEFT JOIN public.invoice_items ii ON ii.invoice_id = i.id
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON ii.order_item_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN public.service_catalog sc ON ii.service_id = sc.id
WHERE i.user_id = $1
GROUP BY i.id, o.doc_no, q.doc_no, u.name, q.id
ORDER BY created_at DESC
